test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

After she received an overripe papaya, Vidya exclaimed that she would never ever________ fruits online.
solution:
The correct answer is **'order'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• From the given options it is clear that we need to select the **appropriate tense form of the verb order** for the given blank. 
 
• In the given sentence, the **independent clause uses the simple past tense form (received, exclaimed). **
 
• According to the **sequence of tenses**, when the independent clause uses the simple past tense, then, the dependent clause uses the simple present tense while stating a general truth. 
 
• Thus, the given blank needs **the simple present tense form of the verb order** which is the word itself. 
 
• Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Ordered" **is the past tense form.
 
• **"Orders" **is the third person present tense form.
 
• **"Ordering" **is the present continuous tense form.
